findings_closed.title: BuybackBurn could remain stuck in PENDING_STONFI_SWAP when upstream ATHWallet notify_value was exactly 35,000,000 nanotons
findings_closed.resolution: ATHWallet now sends AthTransferNotification and AthTransferNotificationMintUsername with SendPayFwdFeesSeparately, so notify_value is delivered as exact destination value instead of being reduced by forward fees.

findings_acknowledged.title: Excess notify/burn TON can accumulate in BuybackBurn balance
findings_acknowledged.resolution: Not fixed in contract. Tests now use the production boundary 35,000,000 nanotons instead of 0.1 TON for the BuybackBurn happy paths, reducing route overpay pressure.

findings_acknowledged.title: Partial RetryAthBurnDue could inflate executed_buyback_count
findings_acknowledged.resolution: Already closed by M35: RetryAthBurnDue.amount must equal ath_burn_retry_due_atomic.

verification.focused_tests: npm.cmd run test:file -- tests\buybackburn-production.test.ts tests\buybackburn-auth-negative-matrix.test.ts tests\ath-burn-finalization.test.ts tests\ath-wallet-transfer.test.ts

production_note: This closes the BuybackBurn -> ATHWallet -> ATHMaster notify boundary liveness risk. Production remains blocked by the existing mainnet route, funding, address, and final-genesis evidence gates.
